label: Уходить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for уходить (to leave, to go away).

missions.phrase: Я ухожу с работы в шесть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Уходить is imperfective. Note the 1sg mutation д → ж in 'ухожу', against уходишь elsewhere. 'С работы' shows departure from a place.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Уходишь' keeps the unmutated стем уход- with the -ишь ending. The present can mark an imminent leaving.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Уходит' takes the -ит ending. 'Каждый вечер' brings out the habitual reading of imperfective уходить.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Уходим' uses the -им ending. Here the present announces an action happening right now.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Уходят' closes the present set with the -ят ending. 'Один за другим' pictures the ongoing departure.

missions.phrase: Он ушёл, не сказав ни слова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. The perfective partner уйти gives 'ушёл' for a single completed departure, contrasting with imperfective уходил.
Strategic focus: Imperfective past, feminine. 'Уходила' adds the feminine -ла ending. The imperfective stresses the drawn-out manner of leaving.
Strategic focus: Imperfective past, plural. 'Уходили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'Каждый день' marks the repeated, habitual departure.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular negative. 'Уходи' is the informal command of уходить; with 'не' it pleads against leaving. Negative imperatives prefer the imperfective.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Уходить' stays in the dictionary form after 'пора'. The imperfective infinitive names the act of departing.
